text.offer: Meidei says, "Past Kardde's Canyon and the Waylay Oasis, the desert begins. There was a causeway across it once, before it fell. The caravans that still go that way say a mana node hums under the broken stones. The desert's no place for the weak, mind."
text.progress: From the Bhrama & Falcon: South Barloque, out the main gate, through Kardde's Canyon to the Waylay Oasis, then on to the Collapsed Causeway.
text.complete: Sand in your boots and magic in your blood. Sit down, the first one's on me.

steps.objective: Bond with the node at the Collapsed Causeway
